content: Always have a backup for pricing tools: If the online tool is down, use a printed price list or call a colleague to confirm, rather than relying on memory, to maintain credibility.

Secure a specific follow-up time: When a customer says 'déjame pensarlo', immediately set a concrete appointment (e.g., 'I'll call you at 10 AM tomorrow') and offer a time-limited incentive to encourage return.
Leverage the husband's involvement: Since Rosa has low decision power, invite her husband to the store for a joint demo or offer a 'spouse discount' to close the deal faster.

Use scarcity effectively: In round 9, the salesperson started to say 'hold this unit and the bundle price for...' but didn't specify a deadline. Always state a clear expiration (e.g., 'until tomorrow 6 PM').
Avoid mentioning tool downtime: Instead of saying the tool is down, say 'Let me check the latest pricing for you right now' and use a printed list or manual calculation to maintain confidence.

name: Personal Guarantee Bundle
condition: When customer is price-sensitive and skeptical, and the pricing tool is unavailable.
example: Offer a fixed bundle price with a personal guarantee to cover any difference, and include a free accessory to sweeten the deal.

name: Side-by-Side Demo with Visual Contrast
condition: When customer has a specific pain point (e.g., eye strain) and is comparing with a competitor.
example: Set up two devices side by side showing the same content (e.g., a cartoon) to highlight the anti-glare advantage, then ask a question like 'Which one is easier on your eyes?'

name: Signed Quote with Scarcity
condition: When customer needs to consult a spouse or wants written assurance.
example: Write a signed quote with a specific expiration time (e.g., 'Valid until 6 PM tomorrow') and offer to hold the unit, creating urgency.

objection: I need to think about it (déjame pensarlo).
rebuttal_template: I completely understand, Rosa. Let me hold this unit and the bundle price for you until [specific time tomorrow]. If you come back with your husband, I'll also throw in a free [small accessory] as a thank-you. Does [time] work for you?

objection: How do I know the price won't be higher?
rebuttal_template: Let me show you the official Huawei Peru price list right here (point to printed list). The Soft Light Edition is S/ 1,600–1,800. I'll write you a firm quote at S/ 1,890 including the case and protector, and if it's lower, you pay less. I'll sign it now.

objection: I need to check with my husband.
rebuttal_template: Great idea! Why don't you call him right now? I can show him the side-by-side demo on video call. Or, if he can come by, I'll set up the same demo for both of you. In the meantime, I'll reserve this unit with the bundle price until [time].
